input.values: Finite doubles; streaming add or span convenience function
input.execution: Ordinary IEEE floating evaluation; no fast-math/reassociation; intended default rounding

output.value: Compensated double approximation, not exact arithmetic or universally correctly rounded

constraints.errors: Nonfinite inputs invalid_argument; working sum/correction/result overflow_error; failed add preserves state
constraints.precision: No universal fixed error tolerance; cancellation and subnormal handling depend on environment
constraints.snapshot: Value copy is O(1), but no checkpoint/undo/redo API
constraints.threading: Concurrent value reads only without add/reset

complexity.space: Two doubles; O(1) auxiliary space, excluding input

memory_lower_bound.scope: Conservative lower bound on owned payload, not a peak-allocation upper bound; excludes container headers, allocator overhead and caller input

evidence.correctness: Reasoned invariants in documentation; not formally verified
evidence.notes: Cancellation examples and bounded integer sums; nonfinite inputs and overflow preserve accumulator

provenance.implementation: Written for this project; no source code copied
provenance.license: Project distribution license not yet selected
